title: Stage D: reduction of ruling fiber to a ternary conic over k(lambda) unjustified

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Stage D (Lemma `lem:param-min`, Step 2): reducing the generic ruling fiber to a *plane (ternary) conic* over $k(\lambda)$ is unjustified.**

Step 2 says: "Restricting $T$ over $\mathbb{A}^1_\lambda$ and eliminating, the equations of $T$ exhibit it birationally as the affine conic $Q(\lambda;y,z)=0$", a ternary quadratic form, then applies the Tsen lemma `lem:tsen`.

Problems:
1. The generic fiber of a ruled surface $T\to\mathbb{P}^1$ is abstractly $\mathbb{P}^1$, but **in the given projective embedding** a fiber of $\mathbb{F}_e$ can be a rational curve of degree $\ge 2$ (up to $e$). Plain "elimination over $\mathbb{A}^1_\lambda$" need NOT produce a degree-2 plane curve. Presenting the generic fiber as a *ternary quadratic form* requires first constructing an explicit degree-2 model of the generic fiber over $K=k(\lambda)$ (e.g. via the relative anticanonical sheaf $\omega_{T/\mathbb{P}^1}^{-1}$, which restricts to $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(2)$ on a fiber, giving the $g^2_2$ embedding as a conic). This construction is absent.
2. "Smoothness of the generic fiber is automatic" is true abstractly but does not by itself give the ternary-quadratic presentation; that is exactly the missing step that feeds `lem:tsen`.

**Repair.** Construct the conic model fiberwise via $\omega_{T/\mathbb{P}^1}^{-1}$ (or the relative $|{-}K|$ on the conic bundle) and prove the eliminated equation is then a genuine ternary quadratic form of bounded $\lambda$-degree $D$, so that `lem:tsen` applies.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
**Fix for Stage D (Lemma `lem:param-min`, normal form (N2)).**

(Note: a stray one-word "test-ping" comment above was an endpoint-discovery artifact; please disregard it.)

I replaced the unjustified "elimination over $\mathbb{A}^1_\lambda$ gives a ternary conic" step with an intrinsic, effective construction of the degree-2 plane model of the generic fibre, as requested. The (N2) proof now has three steps:

**Step 1 (intrinsic conic model via $\omega_{T_\eta}^{-1}$).** I state explicitly that the naive elimination need NOT yield a degree-2 plane curve (a fibre of the inherited embedding $S\subset\mathbb{P}^M$ can be a rational curve of degree $\ge2$). I set $C:=T_\eta$, a smooth projective geometrically integral genus-0 curve over $K=k(\lambda)$, and take $L:=\omega_C^{-1}$ with $\deg L=-(2g-2)=2$. Riemann–Roch + Serre duality give $h^0(C,L)=\deg L+1-g=3$ and $h^1(C,L)=h^0(\omega_C^{\otimes2})=0$ (degree $-4$). Since $\deg L=2\ge 2g+1=1$, $L$ is very ample, so $|L|$ gives a closed $K$-immersion $\iota\colon C\hookrightarrow\mathbb{P}(H^0(C,L)^\vee)\cong\mathbb{P}^2_K$ onto a nondegenerate degree-2 plane curve, i.e. a smooth conic $\{\widehat Q=0\}$ with $\widehat Q$ a nondegenerate ternary quadratic over $K$. This supplies the $g^2_2$ embedding the critic asked for.

**Step 2 (effectivity + bounded $\lambda$-degree $D$).** I spread the construction over a dense open $U\subset\mathbb{A}^1_\lambda$ where $p$ is smooth (fibrewise Jacobian test), form $\mathcal{L}=\omega_{T_U/U}^{-1}$, use cohomology-and-base-change ($R^1p_*\mathcal{L}=0$ since the fibres have $h^1=0$) to get $p_*\mathcal{L}$ locally free of rank 3, trivialize it, and obtain three generating sections defining the relative anticanonical morphism $\iota_U\colon T_U\hookrightarrow\mathbb{P}^2_U$. A Gröbner elimination over $k[\lambda]_g$ outputs the relative conic as a single ternary quadratic $\widehat Q(\lambda;w_0,w_1,w_2)=\sum q_{ij}(\lambda)w_iw_j$; clearing denominators gives $q_{ij}\in k[\lambda]$ with explicit $D=\max\deg q_{ij}$ — exactly the bounded-degree ternary form `lem:tsen` consumes.

**Step 3 (point + stereographic projection).** Apply `lem:tsen` to the genuine $\widehat Q$ from Step 2 to get a $K$-point $P_0$; stereographic projection gives $\mathbb{P}^1_K\cong\{\widehat Q=0\}\cong T_\eta$; composing with $\iota^{-1}$ and assembling over the rational base yields the birational $\gamma\colon\mathbb{P}^2\dashrightarrow T$, with $k(T)=K(T_\eta)=K(\mathbb{P}^1_K)=k(\lambda,\mu)=k(s,t)$.

I also updated the Stage D complexity paragraph to account for the relative-$\omega^{-1}$ computation and the elimination over $k[\lambda]$ producing $\widehat Q$.

Structural checks: `\begin/\end{proof}` (13/13), `\[`/`\]` (11/11), brace counts and all `\ref{}` targets verified; no LaTeX toolchain in the sandbox so I could not compile.

Honest scope note: the construction relies on standard textbook facts (RR/Serre duality on curves; "$\deg\ge 2g+1\Rightarrow$ very ample"; cohomology-and-base-change for the smooth proper genus-0 family; the ideal of a smooth plane conic is principal), all correctly applied. The previously-asserted but unproven reduction is now a derived consequence.
